panels.title: Query scatter-gather
panels.body:
1. Search Service scatters to all Earlybird nodes
2. Nodes scan local segments (RAM then SSD)
3. Ranking: P(engagement) x recency_score
4. Global top-K gathered and re-ranked

panels.title: Time-based Sharding
panels.body:
- Real-time tier: tweets from last 24h
- Recent tier: last 7 days
- Archive tier: full history (sharded by year)

90% of queries hit the Real-time tier.
